passages.note: Her press release ties the vote to making 'the Trump tax cuts permanent' and ending taxes on tips and overtime, which shows the tax-cut side but does not name a cut to the main rates most people pay, nor a call to cut as far as possible.
Praises narrow relief (tips, overtime, seniors on Social Security), a rung-3 clause [b] item that does not exclude a broad cut to the main rates.

rows.reasoning: Her Aye on H.R. 1 (119th) is a multi-subject reconciliation vote, and her own statements tie it only to 'the Trump tax cuts permanent' and 'No tax on tips, no tax on overtime', which show the tax-cutting side but do not evidence 'Cut taxes broadly, including the main rates most people pay' or 'Cut taxes as far as possible and shrink what government does'. Narrow relief alone does not exclude the broad-cut rung, so no single rung is established.
